The at-most-three-edge bipartite classification and explicit four-edge witnesses establish the sharp threshold; degree allocation over n-1 single-incident columns gives all unbounded fibers. The checker independently compares direct orbit words and formulas and exhaustively classifies \(m\le3\); finite checks are not used to prove infinite claims.
